title: 2.8. Aṭṭhamanaya Vippayuttenasampayuttapadaniddesa
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Rūpakkhandhena ye dhammā vippayuttā, te dhammā katihi khandhehi katihāyatanehi katihi dhātūhi sampayuttāti? Natthi.

Vedanākkhandhena ye dhammā … saññākkhandhena ye dhammā … saṅkhārakkhandhena ye dhammā … viññāṇakkhandhena ye dhammā …pe… saraṇehi dhammehi ye dhammā … araṇehi dhammehi ye dhammā vippayuttā, te dhammā katihi khandhehi katihāyatanehi katihi dhātūhi sampayuttāti? Natthi.
Dhammāyatanaṁ dhammadhātu, Atha jīvitaṁ nāmarūpaṁ; Saḷāyatanaṁ jātijarāmataṁ, Dve ca tike na labbhare.
Paṭhamantare satta ca, Gocchake dasa aparante; Cuddasa cha ca matthake, Iccete sattacattālīsa dhammā; Samucchede na labbhanti, Moghapucchakena cāti. [47]
